Landed: Gerrit 3427 merged as 63684abd66ad5476e601293bb9653e5fd95a443f (patch set 4, including the mutation-gate TMPDIR fix and the advisory fixes). Gerrit 3446 merged as c2dc5d88c99679affabf9a557f10f6c578805757; it rewords the regression test's docstring so that `git grep -n '/tmp/.ticket-sync' -- src tests` prints nothing (verified on the merged tree).

Windows sweeps after both: job 135569438854 (run 44526811291) and job 135597358757 (run 44534782876). In both, none of the 21 tests from the deleted hardcoded-tmp.args failed. The job conclusion is still `failure`, on tests owned elsewhere: halfcrazed-rubbly-whimbrel, scholastic-travelsick-salmon (earlier run only) and refractive-hasty-iguanodon. Not closing until a sweep concludes `success`, as the AC requires.
